lines.1: 「That leaves cooking. We shall take turns.」
lines.2: 「--Actually, I can't cook at all either.」
lines.3: 「What? I was told you cooked for yourself.」
lines.4: 「Ah, yeah. That was sort of a lie--」
lines.6: She fixed me with a murderous glare.
lines.7: It looked as though 'lie' might be a forbidden word where earnest Otome was concerned.
lines.8: 「N-No, it was to put my parents' minds at ease. I-I mean, it would be wrong to make them worry, right?」
lines.9: 「Then how have you been feeding yourself until now? With what are known as convenience-store boxed meals?」
lines.11: 「I'll show you the answer at dinner tonight. Leave dinner to me. We don't even need to shop for ingredients.」
lines.13: 「Speaking of shopping, show me around the neighborhood when it is convenient for you.」
lines.15: 「The school is nearby, so I already have a general sense of the area. There is no hurry.」
